message:
Here is a cheatsheet to keep next to the console.

:::cheatsheet[Troubleshooting from the CLI]
## Interfaces

| Command | Shows |
|---|---|
| `show ip interface brief` | One line per interface: address, status, protocol |
| `show interfaces Gi0/1` | Counters, errors, duplex and speed |
| `show interfaces status` | Switchports: VLAN, duplex, speed, type |

Look for input errors and CRC errors first: they point at the physical layer.

## Routing

| Platform | Show routes | Show neighbours | Show interfaces | Show logs | Save config |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cisco IOS | `show ip route` | `show cdp neighbors detail` | `show ip interface brief` | `show logging` | `copy running-config startup-config` |
| Junos | `show route` | `show lldp neighbors` | `show interfaces terse` | `show log messages` | `commit` |
| Arista EOS | `show ip route` | `show lldp neighbors` | `show interfaces status` | `show logging` | `write memory` |
| Linux | `ip route` | `lldpctl` | `ip -br addr` | `journalctl -k` | `netplan apply` |

```bash
# Linux: the route the kernel would use for one destination
ip route get 10.20.0.1
ss -tlnp | grep ':443'
```

## Subnetting

A subnet with $h$ host bits has $2^{h} - 2$ usable addresses:

$$
\text{hosts} = 2^{32 - p} - 2
$$

| Prefix | Mask | Usable hosts |
|---|---|---|
| /24 | 255.255.255.0 | 254 |
| /26 | 255.255.255.192 | 62 |
| /30 | 255.255.255.252 | 2 |
